about: The game's core terms and the platform terms, per language. Checked against every string by scripts/lang/lib/glossary.mjs (unit test: src/i18n/quality.test.ts). 'term' is the dictionary form; 'accept' lists further stems that count as the same word (inflected and derived forms). 'names' holds the names of verse forms and devices; see docs/language/GLOSSARY.md for how each was chosen.

verse.english: verse (what the player writes: a short poem of two to four lines)
verse.note: In the Romance languages, German, Polish and Russian the cognate of 'verse' means one line, so the player's text is called a strophe/stanza and a line is a 'verso/vers/wers'.
